runtimeEnforcement.approvedReferencePngDigests: Runtime-enforced by auth-visual.spec.ts before screenshot comparisons.
runtimeEnforcement.derivedBaselineDigests: Runtime-enforced by auth-visual.spec.ts before and after screenshot comparisons; baselines are re-derived from the approved exports and compared byte for byte, so --update-snapshots can never overwrite them silently.
runtimeEnforcement.perFrameAllowance: maxDiffPixelRatio per screenshot, read by the spec from this manifest.

sourceDesign.provenanceNote: Five Clubhouse auth frames exported read-only at scale 1 (390×844) and committed unchanged. D7: FZlHy ("Login — check your inbox") is the /login?reset=sent state reached after the forgot-password request. /auth/confirm-invite has no approved frame (D1) and is not covered here.

comparison.viewport: 390×800 CSS px, deviceScaleFactor 1, viewport screenshot. The pen frame is 390×844: its top 44px is the OS status bar (9:41, signal glyphs), device chrome the app never renders, so the baseline is the export with exactly those rows removed (no scaling, no recolor).
comparison.transform: deriveCroppedTopPng(export, 44) in e2e/png-mask.ts; on wzWLt and FZlHy only, paint the 64×64 illustrative logo tile using authLogoMask. D8 mandates the supplied original PNG; the live spec separately checks its geometry and verifies served-byte identity.
comparison.environment: Chromium with the playwright.config.ts deterministic raster flags, service worker blocked, reduced motion, animations disabled, caret hidden, Figtree 400-800 loaded before capture.

calibration.environment: macOS (Darwin), Playwright Chromium, pnpm test:e2e e2e/auth-visual.spec.ts with every allowance 0 so each nonzero residual is reported by the comparator
calibration.allowancePolicy: Measured ratio rounded up to 0.05pp, plus 0.25pp headroom for Pencil-vs-Chromium rasterization drift across OS (Linux CI measurement not available locally). Geometry probes stay exact (±1px, ±2px only for glyph-metric x/width and Pencil-rounded line heights) and are never widened.
calibration.justification: The Figtree font swap (U2) and the Clubhouse redesign (new top bar, sticky action bar, 52px controls, sentence-case copy) invalidate every earlier Inter/Manrope-era PAF-1 baseline and hash; the pinned hashes were replaced deliberately by the new approved frame exports. Residual is text antialiasing/half-pixel placement (Pencil lays out fractional y, Chromium snaps) plus 1.5px control strokes, never layout: structure is gated by the geometry probes.

account-signup.png: EGb2g draws a Google divider+button; the signup route has no OAuth flow and U6 may not add one (behavior-preserving adaptation), so that region is absent and the retained sign-in prompt sits there instead.
